GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.7 (7 Jan 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 562)
7 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Japanese Personnel.
1. Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend and transfer to the authorities of Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp) for incarceration, not later than 2400 (Midnight) 15 January 1946, the following individual:
Name Address
Judicial Major HATA, Itsuro Tari, Kasugabe-Mura, Minakami Gun, Hyoko Ken.
2. Major HATA is reported to have been released from an Army Hospital on 13 December 1945, and to have returned to the above mentioned address.
3. This order supersedes order for Major HATA's arrest issued to the Commanding General, 8th Army, 6 October 1945.
4. In case Major HATA's incarceration may not be affected by midnight 15 January 1946, the Imperial Japanese Government will make a detailed report, giving present location of the individual, reason for failure to arrest, and the date by which delivery to Sugamo may be expected.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
